svg.aria-label: Three-panel decomposition of GitHub Copilot hosted model prefill latency, marginal streaming velocity, and reasoning effort overhead
svg.text: Latency Anatomy · Separating Fixed TTFT / Prefill Floor from Token Streaming
Decomposing Copilot-Hosted Models: First-Token Floor, Burst Decode, and Thinking Overhead
Subtracting the 1-word baseline floor (T_short) from the 500-word run (T_long) reveals true post-prefill streaming speeds exceeding 280–350 tok/s on fast tiers.
A. Wall-Clock Split: Floor + Net Decode (s)
Implied marginal velocity = Long_Tokens / (T_long − T_short). Because "auto" has a 13.72s router floor on 1-word output and 16.02s on 804 tokens, its marginal window is 2.30s (~350 tok/s).
